title: Your North Node, explained
caption: Your South Node is your usual type. Your North Node is the stretch. Look yours up and tell us what you're growing toward.

beats.head: Your *North Node* is where you're headed.
It's not a planet. It's a *point.*
beats.sub: Where the Moon's path crosses the Sun's path, heading north.

beats.head: Your *South Node* sits directly opposite.
beats.sub: Astrology reads it as your comfort zone and old habits.

beats.head: In love, the South Node is your *usual* type.
beats.sub: Familiar feels safe, even when it keeps ending the same way.

beats.head: The North Node is the *stretch.*
beats.sub: The kind of love you haven't tried yet.

beats.head: The nodes move *backward* through the zodiac.
beats.sub: About eighteen months in each sign.

beats.head: Aries North Node? Learn to *ask* for what you want.
beats.sub: Libra South Node: stop keeping the peace at your own expense.

beats.head: Libra North Node? Learn to *share* the wheel.
beats.sub: Aries South Node: let someone else take a turn.

beats.head: Growth feels *awkward* at first.
beats.sub: That's not a red flag. That's just new.

beats.head: Look up your *North Node.*
beats.sub: Then tell us what you're growing toward.
